output_list.criticism: The function allows the owner to mint tokens without any checks, which can lead to uncontrolled token issuance.
The function allows users to buy tokens at a price set by the owner, which can be manipulated to allow for arbitrary purchases.
The function allows users to sell tokens at a price set by the owner, which can lead to the owner selling arbitrary amounts of tokens.
The function has an inverted require statement, allowing arbitrary transfers despite the check.
The function has an inverted require statement, allowing transfers from arbitrary addresses despite the check.
